reason: An Android mobile automation plugin for DeepSeek Harness that uses ADB and UIAutomator to observe devices, execute GUI actions, and verify task progress through a browser interface with approval gates for consequential actions.

summaries.zh: 通过 ADB 和 UIAutomator 在 DeepSeek Harness 中观察并自动操作 Android 设备，执行带验证流程的移动任务。
summaries.en: An Android device automation plugin for DeepSeek Harness that uses ADB and UIAutomator to observe, perform, and verify mobile GUI tasks.

capabilities: Discovers and connects to Android devices through ADB
Performs taps, swipes, text input, key presses, navigation, and package launches
Runs iterative observe-decide-act-verify mobile task workflows
Can trigger consequential device actions subject to Harness approval
Can optionally install an externally supplied Unicode input APK subject to approval
